patterns: - cwe_id: CWE-89 detection_hint: string concatenation or f-string in SQL query safe_example: 'cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_input,))
' severity: HIGH tier: 1 title: SQL Injection vulnerable_example: 'query = f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = {user_input}"
' - cwe_id: CWE-79 detection_hint: innerHTML, dangerouslySetInnerHTML, v-html with user data safe_example: 'element.textContent = userInput
' severity: HIGH tier: 1 title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerable_example: 'element.innerHTML = userInput
' - cwe_id: CWE-22 detection_hint: user input in file paths without basename() or realpath() validation safe_example: 'filepath = os.path.join(base_dir, os.path.basename(user_filename))
assert os.path.commonpath([base_dir, filepath]) == base_dir
' severity: HIGH tier: 1 title: Path Traversal vulnerable_example: 'filepath = os.path.join(base_dir, user_filename)
' - cwe_id: CWE-78 detection_hint: shell=True, os.system(), backticks with user input safe_example: 'subprocess.run(["ping", host], shell=False)
' severity: HIGH tier: 1 title: OS Command Injection vulnerable_example: 'os.system(f"ping {host}")
subprocess.run(f"echo {msg}", shell=True)
' - cwe_id: CWE-287 detection_hint: authentication bypass via header/cookie check without crypto verification safe_example: 'if verify_jwt_token(request.headers.get("Authorization")): grant_admin()
' severity: HIGH tier: 1 title: Improper Authentication vulnerable_example: 'if request.headers.get("X-Admin") == "true": grant_admin()
' - cwe_id: CWE-502 detection_hint: pickle.loads, yaml.load (not safe_load), ObjectInputStream on untrusted data safe_example: 'data = json.loads(user_string)
obj = yaml.safe_load(user_string)
' severity: HIGH tier: 1 title: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerable_example: 'data = pickle.loads(user_bytes)
obj = yaml.load(user_string)
' - cwe_id: CWE-798 detection_hint: literal strings assigned to password/secret/key/token variables safe_example: 'API_KEY = os.environ["API_KEY"]
password = get_secret("db_password")
' severity: HIGH tier: 1 title: Hardcoded Credentials vulnerable_example: 'API_KEY = "sk-live-abc123def456"
password = "admin123"
' - cwe_id: CWE-327 detection_hint: md5, sha1 for password hashing or security-sensitive hashing safe_example: 'hashlib.sha256(password.encode()).hexdigest()
bcrypt.hashpw(password, bcrypt.gensalt())
' severity: HIGH tier: 1 title: Use of Broken Cryptographic Algorithm vulnerable_example: 'hashlib.md5(password.encode()).hexdigest()
hashlib.sha1(data).hexdigest()
' - cwe_id: CWE-330 detection_hint: math/rand or random module for tokens, session IDs, crypto keys safe_example: 'token = secrets.token_hex(32)
session_id = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
' severity: HIGH tier: 1 title: Use of Insufficiently Random Values vulnerable_example: 'token = random.randint(0, 999999)
session_id = str(random.random())
' - cwe_id: CWE-311 detection_hint: HTTP (not HTTPS) for sensitive data, cookies without secure flag safe_example: 'response.set_cookie("session", token, secure=True, httponly=True)
requests.get("https://api.internal/data")
' severity: HIGH tier: 1 title: Missing Encryption of Sensitive Data vulnerable_example: 'response.set_cookie("session", token) # no secure/httponly
requests.get("http://api.internal/data") # plain HTTP
' - cwe_id: CWE-306 detection_hint: HTTP handler for sensitive operation (transfer, delete, admin) without authentication middleware or token check safe_example: '@app.route("/api/transfer", methods=["POST"])
@require_auth
def transfer(): process_transfer(request.json)
' severity: HIGH tier: 1 title: Missing Authentication for Critical Function vulnerable_example: '@app.route("/api/transfer", methods=["POST"])
def transfer(): process_transfer(request.json) # no auth
' - cwe_id: CWE-20 detection_hint: direct use of user input without validation/bounds checking safe_example: 'age = int(request.params["age"])
if not (0 <= age <= 150): raise ValueError("Invalid age")
' severity: MEDIUM tier: 2 title: Improper Input Validation vulnerable_example: 'age = int(request.params["age"]) # no bounds check
' - cwe_id: CWE-200 detection_hint: stack traces, internal paths, or config in error responses safe_example: 'except Exception: return {"error": "Internal server error"}
' severity: MEDIUM tier: 2 title: Exposure of Sensitive Information vulnerable_example: 'except Exception as e: return {"error": str(e), "stack": traceback.format_exc()}
' - cwe_id: CWE-400 detection_hint: unbounded reads, missing rate limits, no pagination on queries safe_example: 'data = request.body.read(MAX_BODY_SIZE)
' severity: MEDIUM tier: 2 title: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption vulnerable_example: 'data = request.body.read() # no size limit
' - cwe_id: CWE-532 detection_hint: password, token, secret, key values in log statements safe_example: 'logger.info(f"Login attempt: user={username}")
' severity: MEDIUM tier: 2 title: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File vulnerable_example: 'logger.info(f"Login attempt: user={username}, password={password}")
' - cwe_id: CWE-284 detection_hint: admin/privileged endpoints without authorization decorator/middleware safe_example: '@app.route("/admin/delete/<id>")
@require_admin
def delete_user(id): db.delete(id)
' severity: MEDIUM tier: 2 title: Improper Access Control vulnerable_example: '@app.route("/admin/delete/<id>")
def delete_user(id): db.delete(id) # no auth check
' - cwe_id: CWE-916 detection_hint: single-round SHA/MD5 for password storage (use bcrypt/scrypt/argon2) safe_example: 'hashed = bcrypt.hashpw(password.encode(), bcrypt.gensalt(rounds=12))
' severity: MEDIUM tier: 2 title: Use of Password Hash With Insufficient Computational Effort vulnerable_example: 'hashed = hashlib.sha256(password.encode()).hexdigest()
' - cwe_id: CWE-319 detection_hint: unencrypted connections (SMTP, FTP, HTTP) for sensitive data safe_example: 'smtp = smtplib.SMTP_SSL("mail.example.com", 465)
' severity: MEDIUM tier: 2 title: Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information vulnerable_example: 'smtp = smtplib.SMTP("mail.example.com") # no TLS
' - cwe_id: CWE-611 detection_hint: XML parsing without disabling external entities safe_example: 'parser = etree.XMLParser(resolve_entities=False)
tree = etree.parse(user_xml, parser)
' severity: MEDIUM tier: 2 title: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference vulnerable_example: 'tree = etree.parse(user_xml) # XXE possible
' - cwe_id: CWE-943 detection_hint: MongoDB/NoSQL queries with unvalidated user input (object injection) safe_example: 'db.users.find({"username": str(user_input)}) # ensure string type
' severity: MEDIUM tier: 2 title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic vulnerable_example: 'db.users.find({"username": user_input}) # NoSQL injection
' - cwe_id: CWE-326 detection_hint: RSA < 2048 bits, AES < 128 bits, DES/3DES usage safe_example: 'key = RSA.generate(2048) # minimum 2048-bit for RSA
' severity: MEDIUM tier: 2 title: Inadequate Encryption Strength vulnerable_example: 'key = RSA.generate(1024)
' - cwe_id: CWE-307 detection_hint: login/auth endpoint without rate limiting, account lockout, or backoff safe_example: '@app.route("/login", methods=["POST"])
@rate_limit(max_attempts=5, window=300)
def login(): return check_password(request.json)
' severity: MEDIUM tier: 2 title: Improper Restriction of Excessive Authentication Attempts vulnerable_example: '@app.route("/login", methods=["POST"])
def login(): return check_password(request.json) # no rate limit
'

compiled-workflow.instructions:
--- name: bmad-security-review description: 'CWE-based security vulnerability scanner. Reviews a code diff plus modified source files against bundled CWE pattern catalogues and emits a structured JSON findings report. Use in parallel with code-review reviewers for security-sensitive changes.' ---
# Security Review Workflow
**Goal:** Scan the embedded git diff and source files for security vulnerabilities matching known CWE patterns, then emit a structured JSON report with severities and confidence scores.
**Your Role:** Security vulnerability scanner performing CWE-based code analysis.
- READ-ONLY: never edit files. Output the JSON report between the markers below; the orchestrator captures it from stdout. - All inputs (security patterns, modified source files, git diff) are EMBEDDED in the CONTEXT section — do NOT attempt to read upstream files. - Communicate all responses in `{communication_language}`; emit the report in `{document_output_language}`.
## Conventions
- Bare paths (e.g. `patterns/core.yaml`) resolve from the skill root. - `/private/var/folders/c8/4hyhkyxn3xz219khx9yp4l100000gp/T/bmad-assist-snapshot-projects/bmad-security-review/proj/.claude/skills/bmad-security-review` resolves to this skill's installed directory (where `customize.toml` lives). - `/private/var/folders/c8/4hyhkyxn3xz219khx9yp4l100000gp/T/bmad-assist-snapshot-projects/bmad-security-review/proj`-prefixed paths resolve from the project working directory. - `bmad-security-review` resolves to the skill directory's basename.
## On Activation
### Step 1: Resolve the Workflow Block
Run: `python3 /private/var/folders/c8/4hyhkyxn3xz219khx9yp4l100000gp/T/bmad-assist-snapshot-projects/bmad-security-review/proj/_bmad/scripts/resolve_customization.py --skill /private/var/folders/c8/4hyhkyxn3xz219khx9yp4l100000gp/T/bmad-assist-snapshot-projects/bmad-security-review/proj/.claude/skills/bmad-security-review --key workflow`
**If the script fails**, resolve the `workflow` block yourself by reading these three files in base → team → user order and applying the same structural merge rules as the resolver:
1. `/private/var/folders/c8/4hyhkyxn3xz219khx9yp4l100000gp/T/bmad-assist-snapshot-projects/bmad-security-review/proj/.claude/skills/bmad-security-review/customize.toml` — defaults 2. `/private/var/folders/c8/4hyhkyxn3xz219khx9yp4l100000gp/T/bmad-assist-snapshot-projects/bmad-security-review/proj/_bmad/custom/bmad-security-review.toml` — team overrides 3. `/private/var/folders/c8/4hyhkyxn3xz219khx9yp4l100000gp/T/bmad-assist-snapshot-projects/bmad-security-review/proj/_bmad/custom/bmad-security-review.user.toml` — personal overrides
Any missing file is skipped. Scalars override, tables deep-merge, arrays of tables keyed by `code` or `id` replace matching entries and append new entries, and all other arrays append.
### Step 2: Execute Prepend Steps
Execute each entry in `` in order before proceeding.
### Step 3: Load Persistent Facts
Treat every entry in `- file:{project-root}/**/project-context.md` as foundational context you carry for the rest of the workflow run. Entries prefixed `file:` are paths or globs under `/private/var/folders/c8/4hyhkyxn3xz219khx9yp4l100000gp/T/bmad-assist-snapshot-projects/bmad-security-review/proj` — load the referenced contents as facts. All other entries are facts verbatim.
### Step 4: Load Config
Load config from `/private/var/folders/c8/4hyhkyxn3xz219khx9yp4l100000gp/T/bmad-assist-snapshot-projects/bmad-security-review/proj/_bmad/bmm/config.yaml` and resolve:
- `project_name`, `user_name` - `communication_language`, `document_output_language` - `date` as system-generated current datetime
### Step 5: Greet the User
Greet `{user_name}`, speaking in `{communication_language}`.
### Step 6: Execute Append Steps
Execute each entry in `` in order.
Activation is complete. Begin the workflow below.
## Paths
- `pattern_dir` = `/private/var/folders/c8/4hyhkyxn3xz219khx9yp4l100000gp/T/bmad-assist-snapshot-projects/bmad-security-review/proj/.claude/skills/bmad-security-review/patterns/`
## Input Files
| Input | Description | Path Pattern(s) | Load Strategy | |-------|-------------|------------------|---------------| | security_patterns | Tier-prioritized CWE pattern YAML (loaded by compiler) | `/private/var/folders/c8/4hyhkyxn3xz219khx9yp4l100000gp/T/bmad-assist-snapshot-projects/bmad-security-review/proj/.claude/skills/bmad-security-review/patterns/*.yaml` | EMBEDDED | | git_diff | Diff under analysis (PRIMARY TARGET) | injected as `[git-diff]` | EMBEDDED | | source_files | Modified source files (full bodies for inter-procedural tracing) | injected via real file paths | EMBEDDED_IF_PRESENT |
## Execution
<workflow>
<critical>SCOPE LIMITATION: You are a READ-ONLY SCANNER. Do NOT create files, do NOT modify files, do NOT use Write/Edit/Bash tools. Output the JSON report to stdout between the SECURITY_REPORT_START / SECURITY_REPORT_END markers.</critical>
<critical>All security patterns and source context are EMBEDDED in the CONTEXT section — do NOT attempt to read upstream pattern files or modified sources.</critical>
<step n="1" goal="Scan diff against CWE patterns + score findings"> <action>Review every changed line in `[git-diff]` against the embedded `security-patterns` catalogue. Trace data flow through callees that are present in the embedded source files; flag UNVERIFIED when a callee is absent.</action> <action>For each potential vulnerability capture: matched `cwe_id`, severity (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), confidence in [0.0, 1.0] (1.0 exact match • 0.8 strong • 0.6 ambiguous • 0.4 possible • 0.2 weak), and specific remediation with a safe alternative.</action> <action>Exclusions are narrow: skip test files (unless they contain production credentials) and generated/vendored code. Ambiguous findings ship with low confidence (0.2-0.4) — do NOT silently omit them.</action> </step>
<step n="2" goal="Mandatory zero-finding re-examination"> <check if="step 1 produced zero findings"> <action>Re-examine the diff for: missing auth on HTTP handlers, SSRF (user-controlled URLs), missing rate limits on auth endpoints, unbounded resource consumption (goroutine spawning, unlimited reads), sensitive data in logs or error responses.</action> <action>If still zero, include a top-level `notes` string in the JSON explaining why.</action> </check> </step>
<step n="3" goal="Emit structured JSON report (stdout)"> <critical>OUTPUT FORMAT: your entire output MUST be ONLY the JSON between the markers. The first line MUST be `<!-- SECURITY_REPORT_START -->` and the last MUST be `<!-- SECURITY_REPORT_END -->`. Any text outside these markers FAILS the review.</critical>
<action>Emit between the markers:
``` <!-- SECURITY_REPORT_START --> {"findings": [{"id": "SEC-001", "file_path": "path/to/file.go", "line_number": 42, "cwe_id": "CWE-330", "severity": "HIGH", "title": "Weak Random Number Generator", "description": "math/rand used for security-sensitive operation instead of crypto/rand", "remediation": "Replace math/rand with crypto/rand for cryptographic operations", "confidence": 0.95}]} <!-- SECURITY_REPORT_END --> ``` </action>
<action>Field rules: every finding has all fields shown • `severity` ∈ {HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW} • `confidence` is a float in [0.0, 1.0] • `id` format `SEC-NNN` sequential from SEC-001 • when no findings, emit `{"findings": [], "notes": "..."}`.</action> </step>
</workflow>
